jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Eggplant manual

varieties.name: Black Beauty
varieties.supplier_notes: Standard purple oval; main fresh-market variety.

varieties.name: Long Purple
varieties.supplier_notes: Elongated fruit; popular in Indian-Kenyan cuisine markets.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow seed in nursery trays at 0.5cm depth.
Spray for shoot/fruit borer — the main eggplant pest.
Pick fruits at 12-15cm, glossy and firm. Cut with shears.
timeline_template.tip_en: Pick every 5-7 days. Overripe fruits become bitter.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: glossy, firm, no blemishes. Grade B: minor scuff or shape variation.
post_harvest.storage_tips_en: 10-12°C cool storage. Don't refrigerate — chilling injury below 10°C.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (tip damage) · High (bored fruit, market loss)
diseases.symptoms_en: Wilting shoot tips with bore holes, frass at entry, bored fruit with exit holes.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Ncha za machipukizi zinazonyauka zenye mashimo, kinyesi kwenye mlango, matunda yaliyotobolewa.
diseases.treatment_en: Emamectin-benzoate-class at first tip damage; remove and destroy bored shoots. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za emamectin benzoate mara ncha zinapoanza; ondoa na uteketeze. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Rogue infested shoots weekly, crop rotation.
diseases.prevention_sw: Ondoa machipukizi yaliyoathirika kila wiki, zungusha.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the bored shoot tip — the entry hole is the diagnosis.

diseases.symptoms_en: Pin-prick holes on young fruit, frass at entry, larvae inside, fruit rots.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Mashimo madogo kwenye matunda machanga, kinyesi kwenye mlango, viluwiluwi ndani.
diseases.treatment_en: Emamectin-benzoate-class at first punctures; remove infested fruit. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za emamectin benzoate mara mashimo yanapoanza; ondoa yaliyoathirika. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.scanner_notes: Cut-open fruit shows the larva — fruit photo + cut-open.

diseases.symptoms_en: Green wilt of one side, no recovery, milky ooze from a cut stem in water.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kunyauka kwa kijani upande mmoja, hakuna kupona, ute mweupe kutoka shina.
diseases.treatment_en: None — rogue and destroy; long rotation away from solanaceous crops. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; zungusha mbali na solanaceous. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Certified seed, clean tools, avoid flooding.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mbegu zilizothibitishwa, vifaa safi, epuka mafuriko.
diseases.scanner_notes: Cut-stem ooze test is the verification.

diseases.symptoms_en: One-sided yellowing, V-shaped leaf lesions, wilt despite watering.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kuwitikia upande mmoja, madoa ya umbo la V, kunyauka hata kwa kumwagilia.
diseases.treatment_en: None — remove plants; rotation away from solanaceous crops. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ondoa mimea; zungusha mbali na solanaceous. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Solarize beds where present, resistant rootstocks where available.
diseases.prevention_sw: Weka jua kwenye vitanda, mashina sugu yalipo.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Steady demand; grade by size, gloss and firmness. The bore-hole is the first thing the buyer checks.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Mahitaji ya kudumu; panga daraja kwa ukubwa, uangavu na uimara. Mnunuzi huangalia mashimo kwanza.
market_notes.price_notes_en: 40–80 KES per kg retail (November 2026). Blemish-free fruit sells two grades up.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: KES 40–80 kwa kilo rejareja (Novemba 2026). Matunda bila madoa yanauzwa daraja mbili juu.
